content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional platforms like Gumroad impose significant fees, often taking up to 10% on every sale. This is particularly burdensome for digital creators in emerging markets. COREMERCH provides a sovereign infrastructure that eliminates these fees. With NOWPayments, you only pay a 0.5% transaction fee, which means more profit for you. For instance, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains an impressive $921 in your pocket. This infrastructure turns what was once a disadvantage into a powerful opportunity for creators to thrive in the digital marketplace.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital commerce stack, gather the necessary tools. You need a domain to host your store, which can be acquired at minimal cost. Familiarize yourself with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting and understand how to utilize Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. Additionally, set up a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets for managing your orders, and prepare your product files in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivery. Each of these components is free, ensuring that you can launch without upfront investment. This foundation empowers you to control your sales process completely.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Integrating payment processing is crucial for success. Start by configuring NOWPayments to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring you appeal to a global audience. The integration is straightforward, and you can set it up to automatically verify on-chain payments with minimal fees. For delivery, use either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the distribution of your digital products upon payment confirmation. This setup guarantees that your customers receive their purchases instantly, enhancing their experience while streamlining your workflow. Remember, this architecture is designed for your autonomy, meaning you retain full control over the process.
Eliminate platform fees and keep more profit with a 0.5% transaction fee.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your stack is set up, it's time to go live. Publish your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring all links are functional. Test your payment setup by making a small transaction with a cryptocurrency you accept. This will verify that your system is working as intended and that customers will receive their products promptly. Monitor the process closely to identify any issues that may arise and resolve them immediately. The first transaction can be a significant milestone, marking your official entry into the digital product marketplace with a self-sufficient, robust infrastructure.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching, focus on scaling your operations. Analyze your sales data to identify trends in customer purchases, and consider expanding your product range to meet demand. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which contains all six blueprints and seven templates, to enhance your offerings and grow your brand. Automate repetitive tasks wherever possible, ensuring that your time can be spent on marketing and customer engagement. With a solid infrastructure in place, the potential for growth is limitless as you reach new markets and increase your sales volume.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, establish your own digital commerce stack using COREMERCH. This allows you to accept cryptocurrency payments directly through NOWPayments, eliminating reliance on traditional platforms. With reduced fees and full control of your sales process, you can maximize profits and streamline product delivery.
Retain full control over your digital products and customer data.

If you're looking to sell digital products without the constraints of platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, COREMERCH offers the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to get you started. Explore your options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html and take the first step toward sovereign commerce.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Acquire a domain for your online store. 2. Choose between GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. 3. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 4. Organize your order management with Supabase or Google Sheets. 5. Prepare product files for automatic delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing. 7. Run test transactions to verify your setup. 8. Launch your store and promote it to your audience.
